svg.title: Every task against every tool: a square per run, of 12 per tool, coloured as passed, failed by the agent's mistake, failed by the tool's fault or failed with the reviewers unable to settle why, and each tool's typical time for the runs it passed on one axis.
svg.text: How each task went, tool by tool
Left: each square is one run, six per agent, coloured by how it ended. Right: each tool's typical time for
the runs it passed, further left is faster. A hollow dot means only one agent passed enough runs to time.
Failed: the reviewers could not settle why
